test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are two sections A and B of a class, consisting of 18 and 22 students, respectively. If the average weight of section A is 40 kg and that of section B is 35 kg, find the average weight of the whole class.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of students in **Section A** and **Section B** = 18 : 22 = 9 : 11.

Using **weighted average** formula: Average = (9 × 40 + 11 × 35) ÷ (9 + 11)

Average = (360 + 385) ÷ 20 = 745 ÷ 20 = 37.25 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.25 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0313076a3d3a2ad1d6a02c550d0cd78d860bead964ca1bca0638dbd93aa752c9.png] 

**Given:**

Students in **Section A** (n₁) = 18, Average weight (w₁) = 40 kg

Students in **Section B** (n₂) = 22, Average weight (w₂) = 35 kg

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁w₁ + n₂w₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of **Section A** = 18 × 40 = 720 kg

⇒ Total weight of **Section B** = 22 × 35 = 770 kg

⇒ Total weight of the whole class = 720 + 770 = 1490 kg

⇒ Total number of students = 18 + 22 = 40

⇒ Average weight of the whole class = 1490 ÷ 40 = 37.25 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 37.25 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Concept

When groups of different sizes are combined, the overall average is the sum of all individual values divided by the total count: Aₐvg = (Σnᵢxᵢ) ÷ Σnᵢ.

Alligation Method

The ratio of the quantities is inversely proportional to the difference between their averages and the mean average: (n₁/n₂) = (A₂ − Aₘ) ÷ (Aₘ − A₁).</p
